title: Idols; Louis, King Oliver and Mama Lucy
summary: Punch says Louis' mother was King Oliver's sweetheart, which got Louis the second trumpet job; neither taught the other, and he asks after Louis' sister.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Who were your idols, people that you really looked up to? Well, Lewis was one, after he got that big name in Chicago.

We all was playing alike. There was no differences. And Lewis, mother, was King King. And he was a big fan of the band. And Lewis' mother was King Oliver's sweetheart. Uh-huh. See? And the woman, King Oliver, wanted a second trumpet player. So, didn't mean he or Buddy Petit and him. He said, for Lewis. That was his mother's son. So, that's how he got that great hit of us. But then there was a good day we'd have made the same time.
Did you teach Lewis? No. Any songs?
Uh-uh. No, we just learned our own stuff. Everybody learned their own stuff.
What ever happened to Lewis' sister, you know? Mama Lucy, you called her?
Yeah? No, I heard she died. I don't know if I'm true. I heard she died.
Did you know her? Yeah, sure I knew her.
I ain't seen her no more. I know that much.
